register.proposition: The signed original will dated 7 October 2021 names Tamsin Vera Kestell as executor and leaves her the residue outright.
register.origin_and_reporter: Ivor's will. Tamsin reported its terms in q7m4; Orla reported the executor and residue clauses in w9d2; Seth confirmed the nomination and outright gift in n4j8.

Record a testamentary nomination and an outright residuary gift, not a grant, a trust office, a trust beneficial interest or a gift of every gross asset.

source_audit.finding: Tamsin's initial report supplies death and address, reported possession and terms of the will, the balance request and the appointment and delivery questions. No kinship term connects her to Ivor here; no standalone graph edge.

The unique reference, session, attendee count and populated current-name field identify Leonie. The extract distinguishes attendee from packet recipient and expressly contains no family statement. Needs r8c3 or its copy in h3p6.

Preserves the reference and assertion, so can replace r8c3 when joined to m5x7. Tamsin identifies her role as a non-attending forwarder. Not a second witness or a standalone identification of the child.

Orla's first-hand sighting supplies two standalone routes for Ivor-to-Tamsin: the birth entry and the will's daughter clause. Also records the will terms, death particulars and return of all three papers.

The estate note itself reports the birth entry and daughter clause with locally identifiable endpoints, so either passage can ground Ivor-to-Tamsin without w9d2. It summarizes the same instruments. It also establishes custody, the lack of an application at intake, copy provenance, production dates, communication arrangements and the outstanding balance. It does not reproduce the DP-7316 assertion or identify its attendee; it cannot replace either half of that edge's proof.
